info.title: Drilling reports GraphRAG: read path
info.description: Ask a question about the loaded drilling reports and see the answer, the lanes that gave its evidence, its citations and how it was reached. Specification §7.5.

reasoning.description: Set for a question about causes

source.title: Source

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.description: The page's chunks in reading order

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Path of the page image when it has been rendered (platform/render_pages.py), else null

depth_ft.title: Depth Ft
depth_ft.description: Lowest and highest end depth of its events, ft

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: A drilling problem found in the event graph: a run of non-productive events with one code.

code.title: Code
code.description: A word for a program: busy, model_unavailable, store_unavailable, not_found, invalid_request, internal

question_id.title: Question Id
question_id.description: The log ID of the question, when one was logged

by_verdict.title: By Verdict
by_verdict.description: right, wrong and none (not marked), by the latest mark

lane.title: Lane
lane.description: Force one lane instead of the coordinator's route

total.title: Total
total.description: Questions matching the filters, over all pages

expected_lane.title: Expected Lane
expected_lane.description: Absent unless chosen at export: the coordinator then takes it as reasoning, so routing scores of the file mean nothing

collected.title: Collected
collected.description: On which date, how many questions and with which filters

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Empty: the gold facts a person writes

QuestionSetFile.title: QuestionSetFile
QuestionSetFile.description:
A question file in the format of graphrag/gold/, which `python -m graphrag.coordinator answer --questions
<file>` runs; a person adds the gold facts later.

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: One per depth, shallowest first; context.depth_ft is the depth

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: Questions waiting for the model now

problem.description: The problem the answer is about; null when several match and the user is asked which

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Every problem that matched the question

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: What code gathered around the problem and showed the model

stated.title: Stated
stated.description: Causes a report states, each with a citation that code checked

possible.title: Possible
possible.description: Factors visible in the evidence that no report states as the cause; empty in exact mode

possible_hidden.title: Possible Hidden
possible_hidden.description: Possible causes left out because the mode is exact

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: Causes code removed because no citation supported them, by list

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Kinds of evidence a real judgement needs that the reports do not hold

Reasoning.title: Reasoning
Reasoning.description: The answer to a question about causes (specification §8.6).

id.title: Id
id.description: The label the answer cites: E1, E2, ... for events, P1, P2, ... for passages

text.title: Text
text.description: The line or passage exactly as the model saw it

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: For an event: whether it is part of the problem itself

activity.description: For an event: its fields; null for a passage

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Hours logged in the day's operations table

npt_hours.title: Npt Hours
npt_hours.description: Hours of those the report marks non-productive

end_md.title: End Md
end_md.description: Deepest end measured depth of the day's events, ft

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: Activity codes of the day, in the order logged

npt_codes.title: Npt Codes
npt_codes.description: Non-productive codes of the day, in the order logged

report_type.title: Report Type
report_type.description: Null when a fact cites a report this machine does not hold

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: 0 when this machine does not hold the report

context.title: Context
context.description: For example the casing size a depth belongs to

file_id.title: File Id
file_id.description: The report the fact's chunk belongs to

page.title: Page
page.description: The chunk's page; null when this machine does not hold the chunk

general.title: General
general.description: Rig, contractor, API number, elevation and other well-level facts

depths_and_dates.title: Depths And Dates
depths_and_dates.description: Total depth, spud and rig release dates, days and hours

readings.title: Readings
readings.description: Values measured or projected at depths

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: End-of-well reports first, then daily reports, by file ID

report_days.title: Report Days
report_days.description: From the event graph, oldest first; empty for a well without one

WellOut.description: What a page about one well shows, computed in code from the engine; no model call.
